title: Reel kit cards
summary: Reel-kit cards for talking-head footage, 1080x1920, kept in the top safe area above the face. Every piece takes the brand colours as props: accent (#2F5BEA), highlight (#FFE03C), ink (#16181D), paper (#F3F2EF), background (grid | solid). edit-preview and raw-vs-edit draw only what sits around the clip: the clip's card or split is a storyboard layout.
usage: ai-prompt: {"piece": "overlays/ai-prompt", "theme": "ui/reel-kit", "start": 1.0, "end": 3.2, "props": {"text": "turn this into a reel"}}. edit-preview: layouts [{"at": S, "x": 238, "y": 365, "width": 605, "height": 1075, "radius": 65, "shadow": 1, "backdrop": "#2F5BEA", "ramp": 0.4, "ease": "smooth"}, {"at": E - 0.4, "to": "full", "ramp": 0.4, "ease": "smooth"}] with overlays/backdrop ("behind": true) and overlays/edit-preview over it, both S..E. raw-vs-edit: layouts [{"at": S, "to": "split", "x": 552, "second": {"x": 48, "y": 480, "width": 480, "height": 800, "raw": true}, "ramp": 0.3}, {"at": S + G, "to": "full", "ramp": 0.45, "ease": "smooth"}], a zoom over S..E for the edit's punch-in, overlays/backdrop behind S..S+G+0.45 and overlays/raw-vs-edit over with "growAt": G. catalog-grid is a full-frame end card (it draws the backdrop itself).

items.name: Theme backdrop
items.description: The reel kit background: accent colour, soft top-light and a drifting graph-paper grid (background: solid drops the grid). Use it with "behind": true under a card or split layout. Props: fadeIn, fadeOutTime (seconds; 0 = hard).

items.name: Platforms orbiting you
items.description: Nine round platform badges spin in a tilted ring around your head: the front passes below the chin, the back above the head, never over the face. For depth use it twice: half "back" with "behind": "person", and half "front" on top. Follows the face. Props: rise (px to lift the ring), platforms (instagram, tiktok, youtube, x, linkedin, facebook, threads, pinterest, bluesky), half, turns, size, around ("chin", default: the ring passes below the chin; "head": a flatter halo ring at the crown, round the head).

items.name: Crossed-off checklist
items.description: Big modern white uppercase items above the head, each crossed out with a red stroke (its box gets a cross) on its strike time. No card. Props: items [{label, at, strike}], x, y, size, color, strikeColor.

items.name: No apps, no editing (pictures)
items.description: "No apps, no editing" shown, not written: TikTok, Edits and CapCut app tiles (simple original icons) pop in and get red crosses, then slide away for a video-editor timeline (clips, waveform, moving playhead) that gets a red slash. One band above the head or below the chin. Props: y (band top), height (timeline height, default 290), apps [{name, kind, at, strike}], swap, strike, strikeColor.

items.name: Screen recording (scrolling page)
items.description: A browser window filling the frame scrolls down a tall screenshot (ease in and out) with a cursor, like a screen recording. Props: src, imgWidth, imgHeight, from, to, url, dark.

items.name: Proof deck hook
items.description: Hook that shows the payoff first: stills from the finished edit are dealt like tilted cards behind the person (layer 'back', behind: 'person', with the blue grid), while a headline (white line, yellow-boxed second line) and a hand-drawn arrow pointing at the speaker play in front (layer 'front'). Props: images, tags, step, dealAt, headline 'LINE 1|LINE 2', line2At, arrowAt, y, size, arrow {from, to, bend}.

retiredNote: Retired pieces: the full versions are now Effects (library/_shared/signature/catalog.json, named in "replacedBy"). Do not use these in new storyboards; they stay only so older projects still re-make unchanged.

retired.name: AI prompt
retired.description: A chat composer above your head types your ask (text) as you say it, shows a slash-command suggestion chip (suggest, '' hides it), then sends: the button turns into a check and Sent appears. Props: text, label (To Claude), suggest, typeEnd, sendAt (seconds), x, y, width.

retired.name: Storyboard pages
retired.description: Claude's plan as storyboard pages above your head: per shot a thumbnail, the spoken line in serif italic and a note; three to a page, pages flip over the overlay's life. Props: rows [{line, note, image}] (or "line::note" strings), images (thumbnail addresses from the server root, by row), title, perPage.

retired.name: Catalog grid end card
retired.description: End card on the theme background: Comment “KEYWORD” with a highlight pill (and I'll send all N effects), then a numbered grid of your effects or reels fills in tile by tile with labels; '+N more' when total exceeds the grid. Props: keyword, total, sub, labels, images (addresses from the server root), cols (4), rows (3), step.

retired.name: Editing with… card
retired.description: The frame around your clip while a layout holds it in a card: spinner and "Editing with reel-edit…" above it, a SPED UP 3× pill, a shimmer sweep and a progress line along the bottom. Props: title, label, shimmer, card {x, y, width, height, radius} (must match the layout window). Pair with overlays/backdrop behind.

retired.name: RAW vs EDITED labels
retired.description: RAW and EDITED tags for a split layout plus the edit's own caption (*word* on the highlight) and tilted title sticker on the EDITED window; growAt grows them with the window to full frame while the tags fade. Props: raw, edited {x, y, width, height}, caption, title, growAt, growRamp, rawLabel, editedLabel.
